annotations.title: Get a bout's stats and fantasy points

description: Per-fight totals for both corners of one bout (strikes by target and position, takedowns, knockdowns, control and position time), each with UFCalendar fantasy points and their category breakdown, plus data-quality flags in meta.quality (rounds present, position data present, whether the round sums match the totals).

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.
